Maya (PM): Quick sync: proposing a 6-week "performance partners" beta. Focus: real-time chat + rerank. Need screening, scoring, and stopgates. Start outreach next Mon?
Aaron (PM Research): +1. Suggest we aim for diversity across 3 personas: chat UIs, short-turn workflows (<200ms), and high-QPS rerank.
Priya (Design): Screener should be tiny. Proposed fields: 1) feature blurb, 2) target p95, 3) avg QPS, 4) incentive preference (credit/case study). Add "what success looks like" checkboxes.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Scoring idea: fit (1-5), effort (1-5), value (1-5). Threshold >=11. Veto on on-prem-only asks.
Sam (SRE): Ops: we can promise a small Dedicated canary for top partners, else hosted with fallback. Need runbook + responder rota before onboarding.
Chris (Legal): If we collect logs/responses, include a consent checkbox and retention options (30/90/365). Default 30. I'll draft the blurb.
deply-bot: merge queued: beta/invite-playbook <- main :party_parrot:
Diego (Growth): A/B test subject lines: A "Help us hit 100ms" vs B "Cut inference costs". Track reply -> integration rate.
Maya (PM): Launch gates (proposal): Recruit >=10 qualified; Onboard >=3 validated in staging; Quality: no >10% regression on core eval; Ops: runbook + fallback verified. Pause outreach if any gate fails.
Aaron (PM Research): Metrics to capture: median latency, cost per 1k tokens, time-to-first-integration, and partner NPS at week 4.
Priya (Design): I'll make a short in-product banner and a 1-page onboarding cheat sheet.
Elena (Solutions Eng): Onboarding checklist: scoped API key, model pinned/version noted, baseline eval artifacts uploaded, canary routing plan (0-20%). I'll include a `curl` snippet.
Sam (SRE): Runbook items: alert thresholds, throttling play, escalation contacts, weekend coverage windows. I'll stub template.
Chris (Legal): Consent snippet draft: "By participating you consent to share request/response logs for debugging. Redwood will retain logs for [30/90/365] days per your choice. Data won't be used for training without explicit agreement."
Diego (Growth): Incentives: $500 credit (startups) or co-marketing/case study (enterprise). Offer a fast-track Dedicated slot for top 2 partners.
Maya (PM): Action owners: Aaron = screener final + HubSpot form + A/B; Priya = banner + copy; Elena = rubric + onboarding curl; Sam = runbook template; Chris = consent + retention. I'll assemble 1-pager by Thu EOD.
Elena (Solutions Eng): I'll help triage invites and schedule staging runs.
Sam (SRE): Stubbing runbook now, will ping for review.
Aaron (PM Research): Will set up the form and experiment tracking.
Priya (Design): +1, will post mockups by Wed.
Chris (Legal): Will review final playbook before send.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. If no objections, outreach next Mon. :rocket:
